basic_info.description: Nestled in bucolic Forest Hill Extension, noted for its quintessential San Francisco rolling hills and central location, this fully detached Mediterranean home is bright and inviting. With a welcoming foyer, the impressive living room boasts large arched windows, high ceilings with beam details, fireplace and rich hardwood floors, creating a warm and alluring home ambiance. Ideal for entertaining, the handsome dining room, adorned with unique trim and wide planked floors, adjoins both kitchen and living room. The classically-styled kitchen features updated cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless appliances and charming breakfast room with pantry. Down the skylit hallway are two amply sized bedrooms with roomy wardrobes and picturesque Forest Hill neighborhood outlooks. A full and half bath completes the primary level. With serene green views, the spacious family room offers flexibility on the lower level- to be used as a retreat, home office or third bedroom, with a full bathroom off the hallway. A generous garage with ample storage and great ceiling height complete this wonderful home. Centrally located near Forest Hill Muni station, just minutes from West Portal Village's dining and shops, 26 Idora provides a blend of character and modern convenience in a sweet location.
